notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes: Small patch to fix some bug in the starting tutorial.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
A combat tutorial stage has been added. The NPC is in the training ground. Please try it out if you have not done it yet.

Decrease recovery time of all skills. You can now chain skill to normal attack much more faster.
VFX improvements.
Decrease energy cost of the charged laser attack.

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

This update added enemy pre-attack warning effects and several improvements including FX, screen shake and audio. 
The future map content update will be accompanied by a rework on the progression and item system, so it will take us more time.

Bug fix:
[list]
[*]Fix a bug where jump height is incorrect after an attack.
[/list]

notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello,

This is the fist step to improve the combat dynamic, please let us know your opinion.
[list]
[*]Rework on energy, energy will regenerate in combat. Adjusting energy cost of skills accordingly.
[*]Normal attacks will restore energy on hit.
[*]Skill rework for all weapons: Added new skills for all weapons.
[*]Increase attack speed for all weapons. You can now chain normal attack to charge attack much more easier, and chain your skill in your normal attack combo.
[/list]

Bug fix:
[list]
[*]Physics: Jump speed loss when jumping next to a steep slope.
[*]Items: Some item effects were not triggered in coop mode.
[*]Achievements: Some achievements were not obtainable
[/list]

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Increased chest density.
Targeting will stay on your current target if no direction input is entered.

Multiplayer disconnect bug fix.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hello,

We read your concerns and we are trying different way to make the progress more dynamic, but this will take a bit more time. Random map feature will also come a bit later.

Some in game changes:
Decrease luminosity on daytime.
Rework on shop spawn position.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Added a weapon selector.
Added currency indicators.
Decrease boss HP in the first level.
Decrease HP loss on NPC reward.

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Please reset your skills in the power book.

[list]
[*]Decrease skill cost in the power book
[*]Added a short homing capability to the player's projectile
[*]Increase damage and aoe radius for the magic staff
[*]Increase blocking angle for magic staff
[*]Decrease stamina cost for block
[*]Decrease stamina cost for run
[*]Decrease  knockdown resistance for elite enemies on the first map
[*]Delay the appearance of gold chests
[*]Change indicator to elite fights before the boss
[/list]

notes.title: Small patch
notes.notes:
Overall difficulty decrease in the first map:
Decrease enemy number
Increase pause time for enemy attacks

notes.title: Small update
notes.notes:
Hi there,

A tutorial has been added.

Balance :
Decrease the attack of the Light Bearer.

We are debating about decreasing the overall difficulty, what do you think ?

Cheers,

notes.title: Bug Fix Patch
notes.notes:
Hello,

A small patch to fix some identified bugs.

Please let us know your opinion on the game and don't hesitate to report bugs :)

Cheers,

notes.title: Out Now - Get 15% OFF this week !
notes.notes:
Are you ready to explore the world of Mistral ? As the kingdoms hero, you'll embark on a perilous journey to vanquish the force of darkness !

Mistral is out in Early Access and we want to make this an amazing experience.

We have a lot of content planned ahead, like new weapons, new maps, new monsters, more game mode, the list goes on.

Please don't hesitate to let us know your thoughts and wishes on the Steam forum or on our Discord. We are also open to any gameplay/feature suggestion.
